_why: Every OpenSSF Best Practices criterion this repository can answer, with the evidence beside it. Registration at bestpractices.dev is a sign-in and a paste; this file is the paste. It is DATA so docs/CERTIFICATION.md can render it, and every evidence path is a link the contract's link checker validates — an answer citing a file that does not exist fails the build rather than the reviewer.
